latin_incipit: Organum odoratus sunt carunculae mamillares in anteriori cerebri parte constitutae.
charge: Earlier theories placed olfaction in nostrils or nasal passages only.
defense: Avicenna's anatomical work, based on careful observation and dissection, correctly identified brain localization of sensory processing. Validates scientific basis for understanding perception and imagination.

english_translation.text: The organ of smell consists of the mamillary caruncles located at the front part of the brain.
